name: The Outbreak: First Light
source:
The Outbreak: First Light picks up right where Day Zero left off, continuing the parallel stories of the previous survivors.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170627214505/https://theoutbreakseries.wordpress.com/2014/03/15/the-outbreak-first-light-part-1/]official site[/url]]

《爆发：第一缕曙光》从零日结束的地方开始，继续之前幸存者的平行故事。

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170627214505/https://theoutbreakseries.wordpress.com/2014/03/15/the-outbreak-first-light-part-1/]官方网站[/url]]
